Maple Street Dental — Investor and community update, Q2 2026

Leadership. Dr. Priya Patel, Founder & CEO of Maple Street Dental, leads both clinics. The practice employs 22 staff across Austin and Round Rock.

Operations. Maple Street Dental now runs 2 clinics with 14 chairs after the Round Rock clinic opened in April 2026, serving about 6,500 active patients. FY25 revenue was approximately $9 million.

From the CEO. "Filling every hygiene chair is our number one priority this year," said Dr. Priya Patel. She added that the practice plans a third location in Cedar Park in 2027.

Patients. Reviews mention long waits to rebook after cancellations and calls going unanswered at peak hours. The practice is in-network with 12 PPO plans and offers Invisalign clear aligners.
